data.summary: E122 install-test falsification for E068 ArXiv spec generator completed. Experiment ran and all gates FAILED (K1, K3, K4) except K2 (trivial pass with 0% gap). Both generated and ground truth specs fail to install on Python 3.8 due to version incompatibility (numpy, torch require Python 3.9+). No A3/A4 pure-Python repos were successfully tested. The generator's version resolution does not check Python version compatibility. Verdict: FAIL - the spec generator does not produce working environments on available Python version.
